nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$, let $\mu$ be the Haar probability measure on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$, and let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{C}$. For every function $f : \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} \to E$ and every $n \in \mathbb{Z}$, the $n$-th Fourier coefficient $\hat f(n) = \int e^{-2\pi i n t / T} f(t)\,d\mu(t)$ satisfies $\|\hat f(n)\| \le \int \|f(t)\|\,d\mu(t)$.
nodes.title: A Fourier coefficient is bounded by the L¹ norm

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and let $\mu$ be the Haar probability measure on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$. For every continuous function $g : \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}$, the Fourier coefficients $\hat g(n) = \int e^{-2\pi i n t / T} g(t)\,d\mu(t)$ tend to $0$ as $|n| \to \infty$, that is, along the cofinite filter on $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Riemann–Lebesgue for continuous functions

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$ and let $\mu$ be the Haar probability measure on the circle $\mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z}$. For every $\mu$-integrable function $f : \mathbb{R}/T\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}$, the Fourier coefficients $\hat f(n) = \int e^{-2\pi i n t / T} f(t)\,d\mu(t)$ tend to $0$ as $|n| \to \infty$, that is, along the cofinite filter on $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Riemann–Lebesgue lemma on the circle

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
